About the Trip
Tyler & Kirsten's Wedding
AOur Trip for the Wedding

In June 2025, we set off on a grand road trip to Des Moines, Iowa, for Tyler and Kirsten’s wedding. Our journey took us through Arizona, New Mexico, Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Missouri before arriving in Iowa. It was an unforgettable adventure filled with scenic views and memorable stops.

The wedding day was beautiful—joyous and emotional in equal measure. Surrounded by family and friends, Tyler and Kirsten exchanged vows in a touching ceremony followed by a lively celebration full of love, laughter, and dancing.

This trip will forever be etched in our hearts—not just for the wedding itself, but for the shared experience of getting there together.

Las Vegas Here We Come
Our Vegas Trip

When we found out that Tyler and Kirsten would soon be heading off to Iowa, we knew we wanted to send them off in a memorable way. We came up with a challenge: come up with an exciting and fun idea for a family trip. We presented our ideas and then voted for the winner. When it came down to the final planning, we decided to save some time and money and landed on Las Vegas as the destination.

Cindy, Danyel, Tyler, Kirsten and I made the trip. We stayed towards the North end of the Strip at Treasure Island, which gave us plenty of opportunity to walk many, many miles over the four days. I think that was more walking than I had done in quite some time; but it was well worth the time together!

One of the highlights of the trip was seeing the Blue Man Group. It was an unforgettable night—not because of the energy of the show, but because Tyler got pulled up as an audience participant! Watching him on stage, not exactly sure what to do, but seemingly having a blast, gave us all a good laugh and made for one of our favorite memories of the trip.

We also visited the Mob Museum, where we explored the history of organized crime and law enforcement in Vegas. It was full of stories that sparked our curiosity and made for good conversation.

We spent an evening at the Lost Spirits Distillery & Museum (now closed)—an immersive vaudeville-like experience that blended art, science, and a bit of rum. Well, maybe more than just a bit. It was like stepping into another world. Upon leaving we decided food was in order, so we had quite a fun and entertaining drive to the nearest McDonalds; the radio turned up loud and everyone had a great time.

Between shows and museums, we walked for miles (thousands, I am convinced), enjoying the Las Vegas experience, just being together and having great conversations. We ate incredibly well and walked many miles. More than anything, we cherished the time together laughing, exploring, and just enjoying each other’s company.

This trip was about celebrating our family and strengthening the bonds that will hold us together. It was the perfect send-off, and we’re so grateful we took the time to make it happen.

Mom's 90th Birthday Celebration
Our Trip to Rapid City

In April 2024, our family gathered in Rapid City, South Dakota, to celebrate Mom’s 90th birthday. It was a heartfelt and joyous reunion filled with laughter, shared memories, and meaningful moments. From scenic drives through the Black Hills to cozy family dinners, every part of the trip brought us closer together.

One of the highlights was visiting Mount Rushmore and enjoying the breathtaking views of the Badlands. We also made time for storytelling sessions, where Mom shared her life experiences with the younger generations—a priceless gift.

This adventure was more than just a birthday celebration—it was a tribute to the legacy and love that holds our family together.
